title: ℤ₄ as four rotations
caption: Sending k ∈ ℤ₄ to Rᵏ, the quarter turn R = [[0, −1], [1, 0]] applied k times, turns the shape through 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°. A fourth quarter turn returns it to the start, since R⁴ = I, which is why the exponent can be added mod 4.
alt: A small triangle in the first quadrant and its images under R, R² and R³: the same triangle turned through 90°, 180° and 270° about the origin.
description: Start with a triangle I in the first quadrant: the image of k = 0.
R turns it a quarter turn anticlockwise into the second quadrant.
R² = −I turns it through 180° into the third quadrant, and R³ through 270° into the fourth.
Another quarter turn is R⁴ = I: back to the start, matching 4 ≡ 0 in ℤ₄.
